The '''Assay Office''' was a building located in [[Roaring Crater]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. It processed [[Mining/Legends|mining]] claims and was staffed by both [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrats]] and [[Tasari]] natives.<ref name="J15" />
